responses.200: only currently approved authenticated owner's selected task records
responses.401: missing, invalid, expired or replayed delegated identity
responses.403: service or owner consent lacks prp.tasks.read; disabled or revoked

authentication.service_peer: mutual TLS or equivalent separately approved workload-bound authentication
authentication.delegation: producer-verified user-bound, audience- and scope-bound, short-lived OBO assertion, not a raw ChatGPT/user PRP JWT
authentication.subject: verified production PRP owner mapping established under producer owner consent
authentication.nonce_jti: short-expiry anti-replay where required by approved design
authentication.consent_revocation: rechecked by producer on every read

data.owner_filter_source: CurrentUser.id() after producer-side verified delegated principal
data.empty_or_wrong_owner: empty or denied; no fallback to service owner

transport.mcp_outbound: only exact allowlisted internal task-read endpoint; no user-configured URL, redirects or arbitrary Host

review_gates: G0-C explicit producer data-owner consent and protected review
external issuer-subject verified and tied to production PRP owner at producer
non-public service peer authentication and trust rotation
cross-user owner and revoked/disabled account denial
no stage/prod mysql sharing or token copying
real ChatGPT clientId verified on resource
